business_summary: Tiemco Ltd. plans, develops, manufactures, imports, exports, and sells fishing and outdoor products in Japan. The company offers fly hooks, rods, and reels; fly lines comprising floating, thinking, thinking tips, shooting tapers and lines, double hands, saltwater, and backing lines; leader tippets; accessories consisting of fly boxes, line maintenance, fried dressings, indicators, and line cutters; fly tying tools, such as tying vises and tools; fly tying materials, including hackle feathers, hair, dubbing, synthetic, bead weight eyes, thread wires, cement, glue, and wax; finished fried food; polarized sunglasses; apparel and gear; fishing gear; and bags and accessories. It also provides bass, trout, trolling, spinning, and baitcasting rods; bass lures, such as big baits, crankbaits, vibration, minnow shad, topwater, wire baits, frog, rubber and metal jigs, prop baits, and soft lures; trout lures, which include minnow, spoon, and jigs; hard, soft, and ayu lures; snakehead fish; and small fish fishing products. In addition, the company offers men's and women's shirts, jackets, pants and tights, vests, rain gear, and cut and sewn tops; hats and caps, wet wading, fishing accessories, shoes, fishing jackets, wading shoes, insect-repellant clothing, fishing vests, fishing rain gear, and fishing bags. It sells its products through its stores and online under the PDL, TMC, AMPKA, Oracle, Orvis, Cascade, Garki, Gear Aid, Scientific Anglers, Site Master, Sunrise Fly Tying Tools, Semperfly, Tiemco, TIEMCO LURES, Benecchi, Foxfire, Fenwick, Flying Fisherman, Hareline Dubbin, Metz, Richard Whitley, Loop, Renzetti, Ross Reels, UNI, and Euflex brands. Tiemco Ltd. was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Sumida, Japan.
